---
title: "Social Programme"
---

On Tuesday evening, 22 September 2026, the social event takes place at the **Riegele Wirtshaus**,
the brewery tavern of Brauhaus Riegele in the centre of Augsburg. It starts at 19:30. See the
[Programme](program.qmd) for the full schedule of the day.

## Address
[Riegele Wirtshaus](https://www.riegele-wirtshaus.de/)\
Frölichstraße 26\
86150 Augsburg\
Germany

## Getting there

The programme of the day ends at 18:00, which leaves time to freshen up or drop by your hotel before
the evening event starts at 19:30.

For those who would like to travel together, we will leave from the workshop venue as a group at
about **19:00**; the exact meeting point will be announced during the workshop. From the venue, take tram line
**3** towards *Augsburg Hauptbahnhof* from the stop **Innovationspark/LfU** (about a 3-minute walk
east of Building W) and stay on it to the terminus **Augsburg Hauptbahnhof**. From there the
Wirtshaus is roughly 250 m away, a three-minute walk.

If you prefer to head to your hotel first, you are of course welcome to make your own way and join us
directly at the restaurant.

## Brewery tour

If it can be arranged, the evening will open at 19:30 with a guided tour of the Riegele brewery,
followed by dinner at the Wirtshaus. [Brauhaus Riegele](https://www.riegele.de/) traces its roots
back to the brewery *Zum Goldenen Ross*, first documented in 1386, and has been run by the Riegele
family since 1884.

Whether the tour takes place is not yet confirmed; if it does not, we will simply start with dinner
at 19:30. We will let you know closer to the workshop.
